name: TIE/D Defender Elite
description: The TIE/D Defender Elite was an upgraded model of the TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter. It was developed in 1 BBY, at the Galactic Empire's facilities on Lothal. Like normal Defenders, the Elite had three wings, heavy cannons, and a hyperdrive. However, it was much faster and had even more durable shielding. Sabine Wren speculated that it could outclass the Spectres' ship, the Ghost, in terms of speed. It was also equipped with a kill switch, as a security measure.

data.name: TIE/D Defender Elite
data.designer: Darth Vader (improvements on the TIE/d design)
